description: rsi run on CI test speed: one /rsi version 2 run on the PR path that makes the CI Test step faster with no loss of tests or coverage.

userStories.title: Run 5 loops on the CI test suite speed
userStories.description: As the operator, I want a `/rsi` run on the test files so that the CI test step gets faster with no coverage loss.
acceptanceCriteria: The advisor runs `/rsi` on `task/<N>-ci-test-speed` with `--loops 5` and `--slug ci-test-speed-median`, with the scope, metric, holdout, and direction in the Summary.
`.agro/tasks/ci-test-speed-median/rsi.tsv` holds 2 baseline rows and 5 loop rows. Each row has 7 columns.
`.agro/tasks/ci-test-speed/rsi.tsv` holds the 2 baseline rows and the 1 loop row of the stopped first run, unchanged since commit `60712391`.
`git diff --quiet <start-commit> -- vitest.config.ts .agro/cli/vitest.global-setup.mjs package.json pnpm-lock.yaml .github/workflows/` exits 0 on the task branch.
`git diff --name-only <start-commit> HEAD` lists only paths under the scope directories and `.agro/tasks/ci-test-speed-median/rsi.tsv`.
After loop 5, the advisor runs the holdout on the task branch. The holdout prints `0`.
After loop 5, the advisor runs the metric on the task branch. If the ledger holds a `keep` row, the metric is lower than the first baseline metric by more than the baseline noise margin.
The run report prints one `REVIEW` line for each `keep` row.
userStories.notes: Executed on task branch 7e68e678 (start ebfe44e8): ci-test-speed-median ledger 2 baseline + 5 loop rows, all 7 columns; git diff --quiet 60712391 HEAD -- .agro/tasks/ci-test-speed/rsi.tsv exit 0 (first run unchanged, 2 baseline + 1 loop row); git diff --quiet ebfe44e8 -- <evaluator paths> exit 0; git diff --name-only ebfe44e8 HEAD lists cli-first-help.test.ts, hooks.test.ts, standard-skills-link.test.ts, verify-sandbox-image.test.ts and the median rsi.tsv; holdout rerun 0; metric rerun 15491 < 18605 - 1849; report printed RESULT retained gain 18605 -> 14132, kept 2 of 5, and 2 REVIEW lines; pnpm run typecheck exit 0. Loop 2 measurement was BLOCKED once by an invalid margin reading (remote-sandbox.test.ts SIGHUP test timeout) and re-measured under /rsi Resume. Reasoned: /rsi invoked with --loops 5 --slug ci-test-speed-median and the plan inputs (first baseline reason holds the verbatim invocation).

userStories.title: Record manual review evidence
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want the run transcript, the coverage totals, and the CI step time in one file.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/ci-test-speed/evidence/manual-review.md` holds the preflight output, the baseline readings, each loop evaluation, the run report, and the deletion of each worker worktree and branch, for both runs.
The evidence file holds the coverage totals for lines, branches, and functions at the start commit and at the task branch head.
The evidence file holds the duration of the `Test` step of the `Typecheck, Build & Test` job for the last `development` run before the PR and for the pushed PR head.
The PR `## Manual review` section lists each `REVIEW` line.
The operator confirms each `REVIEW` line before the merge. The advisor reverts each kept edit that fails the review, and records the revert in `## Lessons`.
